notes:
Created the reference web chat widget in /root/projects/guest-checkin/app/static/:

1. chat-widget.js (451 lines) — GuestCheckInWidget class with:
   - Constructor taking {sessionId, token, wsUrl, apiUrl, theme}
   - WebSocket connection with auto-reconnect (exponential backoff: 1s, 2s, 4s, 8s, max 30s)
   - Message rendering: guest (right/blue), agent (left/gray), system (centered/italic)
   - 6-step progress bar (Privacy → House Rules → Rental → Info → ID → Incidental) with completed/current/upcoming states
   - Input field with send button + Enter key support
   - State indicator bar showing current step name and required action
   - Secure link cards: URLs containing /id-upload/ or /incidental/ render as clickable cards with lock icon and 'Secure' label
   - Connection status bar (disconnected/reconnecting)
   - Typing indicator (3 bouncing dots) while waiting for agent response
   - Mobile responsive: full-screen on ≤480px, fixed widget on desktop
   - Public API: init(), sendMessage(text), disconnect(), onMessage(callback)
   - Floating Action Button (FAB) to open/close widget

2. chat-widget.css (466 lines) — Full responsive styling:
   - CSS variables for theming (light + dark via [data-theme='dark'])
   - Widget: 400×600px desktop, full-screen mobile
   - Chat bubbles: rounded corners, shadows, max-width 80%
   - Progress bar: horizontal steps with check/current/dot icons
   - Color scheme: primary #2e86c1, accent #28a745, agent #f0f0f0
   - Animations: slide-up, message slide-in, typing dots bounce
   - Secure link cards: bordered with lock icon and 'Secure' label

3. index.html (205 lines) — Demo page:
   - Configuration form: booking reference + API base URL inputs
   - On start: POST /api/v1/sessions → initializes widget with session token
   - Shows session info after creation
   - Clean, professional design

4. app/main.py — Added StaticFiles mount at /static to serve widget assets

All vanilla JS, no frameworks, no build step. Widget is embeddable with just script/link tags.
